text: So how's Angela doing at her new school, Kate? Oh, much better, thanks. I'm so glad we decided to move her to St James's. The teachers seem a lot better prepared, and they push the kids. I think Angela was just a bit bored at her last school. Well, she's a bright kid. And that other school was quite rough. I was always hearing about fights in the playground and kids skipping classes. Well, St James's has a very good reputation. Yes, discipline is very good there, and I think they look so much smarter in a uniform.
